mode: loopback GoTrue Storage PostgreSQL and Chromium

steps.step: already-open previous account page after version publication
fresh old frontend after rolling back the app
fresh paired frontend recovers the published revision

business_scope: The same owner retained access to the same active logical attachment. All files, accounts, sessions and content were synthetic and local. The six exports used normal account-page downloads and checked the ZIP CRC, byte SHA-256 and the corresponding manifest. Unrelated dashboard requests were empty fixtures.
observed_effect: After the first successful replacement, a still-hydrated previous app, or the old app served after a rollback, can export the original bytes even when the user newly requests a ZIP. Reopening the version-aware build exports the current bytes with no repeat upload or write.
limits: This exercise did not deploy either application, migrate a production database, open a real existing attachment, or exercise account merge/device loss.
